segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I saw the note that your Fort Wayne lab is adding a second shift in March. Are you looking at more user seats, or is this more around the calibration due-date reporting?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly seats. We have 18 people in there today, and we need 7 more by March 11. The reporting is fine, though I do want the supervisors to see overdue gauges without being full admins.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 25 total users, with those 7 as standard users, and then supervisor visibility through the manager role. That keeps permissions pretty clean. Your current plan is $42 per user per month, billed annually, so the 7 seats would add $3,528 for the remaining year if we line it up with your June 30 renewal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that math works. Can you make the invoice hit in February? Our finance team is closing January already, and I don't want it bouncing around.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I can set the service start date as March 11 and invoice date as February 12. Payment terms stay net 30, same as your main agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. And no new implementation fee, right? They're already using the same procedures and assets, it's just more people logging in.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, no implementation fee. I do recommend one 45-minute enablement session for the second-shift supervisors. That's included; we'd just schedule it the week of March 4.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do March 6 if you have it. Around 2:00 Eastern catches both shifts for us.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: March 6 at 2:00 Eastern works. I'll send the order form for the 7 additional seats, cotermed to June 30, with the February 12 invoice date and the enablement session noted.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Marisol in finance. If the total is $3,528 plus tax, I can sign it this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's the total before applicable tax, yep. I'll have it over today, and once it's signed we'll add the seats so they're available before the March 11 go-live.
